title-proc.eng: Supply of an automated MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry system (Exent®) for the identification, isotyping and quantification of monoclonal immunoglobulins

description-proc.eng: This is a VEAT notice to indicate that the Mater Misericordiae University Hospital (MMUH) intends to utilise EU public procurement Directive 2014/24/EU, Article 32.2(b), negotiated procedure without prior publication, on the following grounds: (ii) competition is absent for technical reasons; and/or (iii) the protection of exclusive rights, including intellectual property rights. This notice is to indicate that MMUH intends to contract with The Binding Site Group Limited ("The Binding Site") for the supply of the Exent® system, an integrated automated platform based on matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionisation time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS), for the identification, isotyping and quantification of monoclonal immunoglobulins in the diagnosis and monitoring of multiple myeloma and related plasma cell disorders. The justification for this decision is that The Binding Site is the sole manufacturer and supplier of a fully automated, integrated MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry platform validated for routine clinical use in the identification, isotyping and quantification of monoclonal immunoglobulins. No other economic operator manufactures or supplies an equivalent automated, integrated solution offering this combination of capabilities for routine clinical diagnostic use. The system and its associated reagents, consumables and software are proprietary to The Binding Site and are protected by intellectual property rights, and are not available from any other source. The equipment is required for the accurate and timely diagnosis, isotyping and monitoring of multiple myeloma and other monoclonal gammopathies, supporting improved patient outcomes through earlier detection and more sensitive monitoring of treatment response than conventional electrophoresis-based methods. The contracting authority has conducted a market review and is not aware of any other manufacturer offering a fully automated, integrated MALDI-TOF platform providing equivalent clinical functionality. The contracting authority therefore considers that no reasonable alternative or substitute exists and that competition is absent for technical reasons and by reason of the protection of exclusive rights, including intellectual property rights. The direct award is necessary to secure this clinically essential diagnostic capability.

title-proc.eng: Auftragsänderung 1: 81308138 - Expert Pool for Technical Advisory Services on Digital Transformation for Social Protection

description-proc.eng: In times of multiple and overlapping crises, the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) attributes high importance to the development of inclusive and adaptive social protection systems. The global programme "Global Alliances for Social Protection" (GASP) of Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH supports this endeavour through the (i) joint provision of a digital public good (openIMIS), (ii) work on standard setting for interoperability in digital social protection (Digital Convergence Initiative), (iii) support to finance mobilisation for social protection (Global Shield and domestic resources), (iv) enhancement of bi-multilateral cooperation and (v) support to leadership development for social protection. The importance of digital social protection systems and their role in the broader development agenda is gaining increasing attention around the world. Yet, there are few systematic reviews of civil records, population demographics and the socioeconomic status of people and when they do exist, they are often incomplete. This makes identifying potential beneficiary households of different programmes a major challenge. In addition, individual social protection programmes are highly fragmented and tend to operate in silos, which leads to a lack of data sharing among programmes and negatively impacts the ability to plan resources and interventions. Digitisation and data sharing among information systems holds great potential and can make risk protection and poverty reduction more efficient. However, a lack of global standards in the sector prevents the interoperability of information systems within a country and makes it difficult to transfer good solutions from one country to another. To advance the discussion on international technical standards for integrated approaches to social protection systems, the Digital Convergence Initiative (DCI) was launched in 2021 under the umbrella of the Global Partnership for Universal Social Protection (USP2030). DCI aims to build global consensus on technical standards and guidelines for digital systems to enable the smooth exchange of data between programmes and institutions. The new Multi-Donor Action "Supporting the Digital Transformation of Social Protection Systems to Achieve the Goal of Universal Social Protection 2030", funded by the European Union (EU), is co-financing the DCI alongside BMZ. The DCI is implemented by GIZ GASP as the coordinating organisation, in partnership with Expertise France (EF), the Spanish International and Ibero-American Foundation for Administration and Public Policies (FIIAPP), the International Labour Organisation (ILO) and the World Bank. The overall objective of the DCI is to contribute to the achievement of USP2030 through the digital transformation (including standardisation and interoperability) of inclusive social protection systems at partner country, regional and global levels. To this end, the action aims to: - Enhance the knowledge base on interoperability of global digital social protection systems - Develop global digital standards for social protection - Support partner countries in implementing digital transformation and interoperability of social protection systems To realise these objectives, GIZ is looking for support from a consortium or company to: - Develop and support the dissemination of knowledge products and best practices for achieving digital transformation - Support in-country assessment and provide technical guidance to selected countries for digital transformation of social protection systems - Support the monitoring and assessment of impact, effectiveness, and satisfaction with the programme implementation - Provide support for the development and adoption of global digital standards for social protection - Provide general advisory services on social protection and its digital transformation to support global programme activities

title-proc.eng: Dynamic purchasing system for supplementary procurements, assistance and consultancy services for network systems and equipment.

description-proc.eng: Background The contracting authority needs to establish a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for supplementary procurements, assistance and consultancy of network systems and equipment. The need is for the replacement of older equipment and continual procurements for the existing network platform. The network infrastructure supports mission critical functions. Therefore it is necessary to ensure stable access to compatible equipment over time, as well as facilitate high security of delivery, quick handling at errors and robust supply chains. A DPS gives the contracting authority flexibility for varying purchasing needs and at the same time an option for an efficient competition for the individual procurements within the scheme. The scheme shall contribute to the continuation of a standardised network platform with systems that can be integrated easily, administered efficiently and support centralised operation, monitoring and logging. Description of the delivery The scheme includes the establishment of a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for supplementary procurements, assistance and advice for network systems and equipment with the accompanying licences, software subscriptions, support and manufacturer guarantee. The DPS shall cover the contracting authority ́s ongoing need for compatible equipment for the existing network platform. Procurements under the dynamic purchasing system will include equipment within the following categories: Computer centre equipment for SDN core Gateway, routers and aggregation Branch routes, distribution and access switches WiFi Firewall and Security Components Assistance and advice. The delivery can also include spare parts, simple replacement services in the event of errors, documentation, marking, assembly in rack and physical installation. Broad product coverage and high compatibility with the current network platform are requested, so that management, configuration and operation can be carried out equally across the environments as far as possible. Call-offs may require compatibility with the contracting authority ́s technical platform, as stated in Annex 1 - Technical Platform. The scheme shall allow for predictable access to relevant and compatible models, a quick response with errors or capacity needs, as well as supporting safe and stable operation of the contracting authority ́s network infrastructure.

title-proc.eng: RE-26-03 Review and mapping of avalanche and flood hazards in Rendalen municipality

description-proc.eng: Purpose The aim of the procurement is to enter into a contract for consultancy services for reviewing and mapping landslides and flood hazards in Rendalen municipality. Rendalen municipality needs updated and documented knowledge on landslides and flood hazards as a basis for safe area management, building application processing and stand-by. The municipality lacks necessary danger zone maps for flooding in the relevant waterways and there is a need for avalanche hazard assessments in several areas. In 2026, the municipality has received a grant of financial grants from the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE) to carry out investigations of safety against avalanches in steep terrain in nine areas and danger zone mapping of floods in four waterways. In order to ensure uniform and efficient execution, the assignment is announced as one combined procurement. The procurement shall provide the municipality with a basis in accordance with relevant requirements and guidelines, including NVE ́s guidelines for flood mapping and applicable requirements for safety against danger to nature. The results shall be able to be used further in planning, case handling and stand-by work. Contract 1: Review of flood and avalanche hazards Contract 2: Independent quality assurance control Contract 1 will be awarded to the tenderer ranked as number one. Contract 2 will be awarded after evaluation between the remaining tenderers who have not been awarded contract 1, in accordance with the applicable award criteria. Scope The procurement is for consultancy services for reviewing, assessing and mapping avalanche and flood hazards in Rendalen municipality. The assignment includes examining safety from avalanches in steep terrain in nine areas and danger zone mapping of floods in four waterways, as stated in the attached map and area descriptions. The delivery shall include the necessary professional surveys and analyses for the relevant areas and waterways, including review of the available data basis, site inspections, relevant calculations and modelling, as well as the preparation of reports and map products. For flood mapping, the delivery shall, among other things, provide a basis for the identification of flood-prone areas and the accompanying flood zones and flood depths. Documentation and map basis shall be submitted that the municipality can use in area planning, building application processing and stand-by. The delivery shall be clear, verifiable and adapted to further use in the municipality ́s administration. The assignment shall be carried out in accordance with the competition documents and the requirements and guidelines that apply for these types of reviews.

description-proc.swe: För att kunna fullgöra sina uppgifter och presentera kommissionens prioriteringar och policyer i landet är representationen beroende av att bland annat nationella lokala organ, det civila samhället, kommunikationsnätverk, intressenter och informationsförmedlare deltar aktivt. Representationen i Kroatien söker därför en tjänsteleverantörer som ska underlätta driften av kontoret i samband med anordnandet av offentliga onlineevenemang, live-events och hybridevents.
description-proc.lav: Lai izpildītu savas funkcijas un izklāstītu Komisijas prioritātes un politiku valstī, pārstāvniecība balstās uz valsts vietējo iestāžu, pilsoniskās sabiedrības, komunikācijas tīklu, ieinteresēto personu un informācijas tālākizplatītāju aktīvu līdzdalību. Tādēļ pārstāvniecība Horvātijā meklē pakalpojumu sniedzējus, lai atvieglotu biroja darbību publisku tiešsaistes pasākumu, tiešraides pasākumu un hibrīdpasākumu organizēšanas laikā.
description-proc.hun: A képviselet feladatainak ellátása, valamint a Bizottság prioritásainak és az országban alkalmazott politikáinak bemutatása érdekében többek között a nemzeti helyi szervek, a civil társadalom, a kommunikációs hálózatok, az érdekelt felek és a multiplikátorok aktív részvételére támaszkodik. Ezért a Horvátországi képviselet szolgáltatókat keres, hogy megkönnyítsék az iroda működését a nyilvános online rendezvények, élő események és hibrid események szervezése során.
description-proc.gle: D’fhonn a fheidhmeanna a chomhlíonadh agus tosaíochtaí agus beartais an Choimisiúin sa tír a chur i láthair, braitheann an Ionadaíocht ar rannpháirtíocht ghníomhach comhlachtaí áitiúla náisiúnta, na sochaí sibhialta, líonraí cumarsáide, geallsealbhóirí agus iolraitheoirí, i measc nithe eile. Dá bhrí sin, tá an Ionadaíocht sa Chróit ag lorg soláthraithe seirbhíse le hoibríocht na hoifige a éascú agus imeachtaí poiblí á reáchtáil ar líne, go beo agus ar bhealach hibrideach.
description-proc.ell: Προκειμένου να εκπληρώσει τα καθήκοντά της και να παρουσιάσει τις προτεραιότητες και τις πολιτικές της Επιτροπής στη χώρα, η Αντιπροσωπεία βασίζεται στην ενεργό συμμετοχή, μεταξύ άλλων, των εθνικών τοπικών φορέων, της κοινωνίας των πολιτών, των δικτύων επικοινωνίας, των ενδιαφερόμενων φορέων και των πολλαπλασιαστικών παραγόντων . Ως εκ τούτου, η Αντιπροσωπεία στην Κροατία αναζητά παρόχους υπηρεσιών για τη διευκόλυνση της λειτουργίας των γραφείων κατά τη διοργάνωση δημόσιων εκδηλώσεων, ζωντανών εκδηλώσεων και υβριδικών εκδηλώσεων.
description-proc.spa: Para cumplir sus funciones y presentar las prioridades y políticas de la Comisión en el país, la Representación se basa en la participación activa, entre otros, de los organismos locales nacionales, la sociedad civil, las redes de comunicación, las partes interesadas y los multiplicadores. Por lo tanto, la Representación en Croacia busca proveedores de servicios para facilitar el funcionamiento de la oficina durante la organización de eventos en línea públicos, eventos en directo y eventos híbridos.
description-proc.est: Esindus tugineb riigis oma ülesannete täitmisel ning komisjoni prioriteetide ja poliitika tutvustamisel muu hulgas kohalike riiklike asutuste, kodanikuühiskonna, teabevõrgustike, sidusrühmade ja arvamuskujundajate aktiivsele osalemisele. Esindus Horvaatias otsib seega teenuseosutajaid, kes hõlbustaksid büroo tööd avalike veebipõhiste, interaktiivsete ja hübriidürituste korraldamisel.
description-proc.nld: Om zijn taken te vervullen en de prioriteiten en het beleid van de Commissie in het land te presenteren, is de Vertegenwoordiging afhankelijk van de actieve deelname, onder andere van nationale lokale instanties, het maatschappelijk middenveld, communicatienetwerken, belanghebbenden en multiplicatoren. Daarom zoekt de Vertegenwoordiging in Kroatië naar dienstverleners om de kantooractiviteiten te vergemakkelijken tijdens de organisatie van publieke online evenementen, live-evenementen en hybride evenementen.
description-proc.fin: Edustusto tukeutuu muun muassa kansallisten paikallisten elinten, kansalaisyhteiskunnan, viestintäverkostojen, sidosryhmien ja vaikuttajien aktiiviseen osallistumiseen täyttääkseen tehtävänsä ja esitelläkseen komission painopisteitä ja toimintatapoja maassa. Näin ollen Kroatian-edustusto etsii palveluntarjoajia avustamaan toimiston toiminnassa julkisten verkkotapahtumien, live-tapahtumien ja hybriditapahtumien järjestämisen aikana.
description-proc.pol: Aby wypełnić swoje funkcje i przedstawić priorytety i politykę Komisji w kraju, Przedstawicielstwo opiera się między innymi na aktywnym udziale krajowych organów lokalnych, społeczeństwa obywatelskiego, sieci komunikacyjnych, zainteresowanych stron i podmiotów opiniotwórczych. Dlatego też Przedstawicielstwo w Chorwacji poszukuje usługodawców w celu ułatwienia funkcjonowania biura podczas organizacji wydarzeń publicznych, wydarzeń na żywo i wydarzeń hybrydowych.
description-proc.hrv: Kako bi ispunilo svoje funkcije i predstavilo prioritete i politike Komisije u zemlji, Predstavništvo se oslanja na aktivno sudjelovanje nacionalnih lokalnih tijela, civilnog društva, komunikacijskih mreža, dionika, multiplikatora i drugih. Stoga Predstavništvo u Hrvatskoj traži izvođače koji bi olakšali rad ureda u organizaciji javno-digitalnih, događaja uživo i hibridnih događanja.
description-proc.ces: S cílem plnit své úkoly a představit priority a politiky Komise v zemi se zastoupení opírá mimo jiné o aktivní účast národních místních orgánů, občanské společnosti, komunikačních sítí, zúčastněných stran a multiplikátorů. Zastoupení v Chorvatsku proto hledá poskytovatele služeb za účelem usnadnění kancelářského provozu během organizování veřejných online akcí, živých akcí a hybridních akcí.
description-proc.dan: For at kunne udføre sine funktioner og præsentere Kommissionens prioriteter og politikker i landet er repræsentationen afhængig af den aktive deltagelse af bl.a. nationale lokale organer, civilsamfundet, kommunikationsnetværk, interessenter og multiplikatorer. Derfor søger repræsentationen i Kroatien tjenesteydere for at lette kontordriften under tilrettelæggelsen af offentlige onlinearrangementer, livearrangementer og hybride arrangementer.
description-proc.ron: Pentru a-și îndeplini funcțiile și pentru a prezenta prioritățile și politicile Comisiei în țară, reprezentanța se bazează pe participarea activă, printre altele, a organismelor locale naționale, a societății civile, a rețelelor de comunicare, a părților interesate și a multiplicatorilor. Prin urmare, reprezentanța în Croația caută furnizorii de servicii care să faciliteze funcționarea biroului în timpul organizării evenimentelor publice-online, a evenimentelor live și a evenimentelor hibride.
description-proc.por: A fim de desempenhar as suas funções e apresentar as prioridades e políticas da Comissão no país, a Representação depende da participação ativa, entre outros, de organismos locais nacionais, sociedade civil, redes de comunicação, partes interessadas e multiplicadores. Por conseguinte, a Representação na Croácia procura prestadores de serviços para facilitar o funcionamento do escritório durante a organização de eventos públicos em linha, eventos híbridos e eventos ao vivo.

title-proc.eng: Framework agreement for cleaning services

description-proc.eng: Background The contracting authority needs to establish a new framework agreement for cleaning services for several buildings. The aim of the procurement is to ensure a more uniform, efficient and predictable cleaning delivery across the buildings, including new premises that shall be included in the contract. The need includes both existing and coming locations of varying sizes, use and cleaning needs. The contracting authority would therefore like a tenderer who can provide services of uniform and stable quality, at the same time as the delivery can be adapted to changes in scope and needs over time. The procurement shall facilitate good follow-up, clear quality management and equal cleaning standard in all buildings. It is also important for the contracting authority that the delivery safeguards environmental considerations through the use of suitable and environmentally friendly products and methods. Description of the assignment The assignment is for the provision of cleaning services under a framework agreement for the contracting authority ́s buildings. The delivery shall include daily cleaning and periodic cleaning, with needs that vary between the different buildings. The cleaning services will mainly apply to office areas, communal areas and sanitary rooms, as well as new premises that can be included in the contract period. The delivery shall also include floor care and spring cleaning as needed. The Contracting Authority requests delivery with central coordination and local presence, including permanent gender neutral preferred and good follow-up across the buildings. Tenderers shall be able to handle changes and additional needs in a flexible and efficient way. The delivery shall support equal cleaning standards in all buildings and it shall be built on systematic quality follow-up, clear deviation routines and environmentally conscious systems. It is assumed that the cleaning will be carried out with the lowest possible chemical use and with products and methods that are adapted to different surfaces and materials.

description-proc.dan: Description of the procurement: The Danish Agency for Digital Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen) operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified trust service for the management of qualified electronic signature creation devices under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of securing and modernising the signing service to meet the requirements of eIDAS2, the Agency is procuring Data Diode solutions to be installed and operated within the Agency's data centres (currently two). The Contract includes an Option to extend the deployment to a third data centre and an Option to extend the Contract and replace the Data Diode Hardware. The Data Diode solutions must provide one way traffic from the Agency's isolated Root CA environment to other network zones, while preventing any data transfer in the reverse direction. The solutions must support integration with the Agency's existing infrastructure and the required protocols for transfer of files, time information, monitoring and logging data. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Initial Delivery of four Data Diode appliances for deployment across the Agency's production and staging environments in two data centers, together with the required Standard Software and deployment in the Agency's test and development environments; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Standard Software and Hardware, security patching, product lifecycle management and hardware replacement; and (c)Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks) and Options; and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract.

description-proc.eng: As part of its ongoing efforts to pursue its sustainable development goals and achieve the ambitions set out by the Government in its vision for 2035, Cameroon adopted in 2020, to implement the second phase of its vision covering the period 2020-2030, a policy document entitled the National Development Strategy 2020-2030 (SND30). During this phase, the Government intends to bring about the structural transformation of the economy through industrialisation. However, achieving these objectives will require well-structured measures designed to minimise the impact on the environment, particularly in light of the growing momentum of environmental protection initiatives promoted within the framework of the various Conferences of the Parties on climate change (COP), the most recent of which (COP 31) was held in Recife, Brazil, from 10. - 21. November 2025. With a view to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals, Cameroon has joined the Central African Forest Initiative (CAFI), which aims to recognise and preserve the value of the region"s forests in order to mitigate climate change and reduce poverty. More specifically, the long-term objective of the Cameroon-CAFI partnership is to facilitate the acceleration of economic development by promoting the application of the principle of a "green economy" through which Cameroonian value chains are made competitive and meet the demands of international, national and sub-regional markets, whilst Cameroon ensures food security and reduces the impact of the development of these sectors on deforestation and forest degradation. This is in line with the principles set out in the SND30 and defined in the Letter of Intent (LOI) signed between Cameroon and CAFI in October 2024 with a view to realising the ambitions outlined in the sectoral strategies and will underpin the success of the future partnership. In order to facilitate the consolidation and implementation of the Letter of Intent signed for a long-term partnership between Cameroon and CAFI, the partners have decided to envisage a three-year pilot phase. Furthermore, it was decided to implement a sectoral and multi-level coordination project, which will also oversee the portfolio management and coordination of three technical projects funded by CAFI. Its aim will be to strengthen the capacities of national technical bodies for enhanced and inclusive cross-sectoral coordination, and for strategic and spatial planning, in order to move towards a green economy. This coordination aims to build consensus on the planning tools to be developed, the reforms to be implemented and the innovative financing mechanisms for the development of the green economy, which will help to increase the mobilisation and alignment of interventions and funding from the public and private sectors, both national and international.

title-proc.eng: Provision of Sourcing of Short-term and Temporary Locum General Practitioners (GPs) for the Health Sector in Ireland.

description-proc.eng: The Health Service Executive seeks to appoint suitably qualified employment agencies to source short-term locum General Practitioners (GPs) for General Medical Services (GMS) GPs working in rural Ireland. The purpose of this tender is to support access to locum cover for up to 250 GMS General Practitioners (GPs) in rural and remote areas, who are in receipt of the Rural Practice allowance. GPs in rural and remote areas must be able to access reliable locum cover to allow them take leave knowing that their patients will continue to receive high-quality care in their absence. This scheme, developed under the terms of the 2023 GP Agreement, addresses a critical need for rural GPs who often face significant challenges in securing cover for periods of planned leave. It is envisaged that most leave requests will be for 1 to 2 week leave periods. The maximum leave duration that will be requested is a block of 5 weeks in total. Under this scheme, eligible GPs in receipt of rural practice support will have access to a streamlined locum sourcing service. The service is currently provided by one employment agency under a non-compliant pilot programme set up by the National Contracts Office. This tender process is being conducted as an open-style tender under Annex XIV of Procurement directives 2014/24/EU. The required services are listed as Annex XIV services, and accordingly, only Articles 74 to 77 of Directive 2014/24/EC applies to the award of any contract(s) that arise from this process. As such, there is considerable flexibility in conducting the tender process and this is required given the specialist nature of the services required and the very limited market. Tenderers will be ranked and scored according to the Award Criteria stated. The four top ranked tenderers will be offered a contract. The estimated cost is €100k + VAT per year. The contract is for an initial 36-month period. At the end of this period the HSE can assess if the services being delivered are satisfactory or if the requirements of the scheme changes. There are 2 x 12-month optional extensions. The current focus is ensuring that a contract is in place in early 2027
